Early-Phase Clinical Reporting: CDISCPILOT01

ADaM datasets, QC and safety outputs from public CDISC pilot data

Author

Sara Gharouni Saffar

Published

November 20, 2026

Purpose

This report summarises a spec-driven pipeline that derives ADSL, ADAE and ADLB from SDTM data of the public CDISC pilot study, validates them independently, and produces early-phase safety outputs. All data is public example data.

Populations

Population Actual treatment n
Safety (dosed) Placebo 86
Safety (dosed) Xanomeline High Dose 72
Safety (dosed) Xanomeline Low Dose 96
Screen failure NA 52

Quality control

QC Log

Method: independent double programming. QC programs (qc/) were written in base R from the derivation text in specs/adam_spec.csv, without admiral or dplyr, and compared with production datasets using diffdf. QC ADAE uses QC ADSL treatment dates (independent chain).

Scope

Dataset Variables compared Records Key
ADSL TRT01P, TRT01A, TRTSDT, TRTEDT, TRTDURD, AGEGR1, ITTFL, SAFFL 306 USUBJID
ADAE TRTA, ASTDT, ASTDTF, ASTDY, TRTEMFL 1,191 USUBJID, AESEQ

Findings

ID Run Dataset Finding Resolution
QC-001 1 ADSL, ADAE Attribute difference only: SDTM variable labels retained on USUBJID/AESEQ in production, dropped by base R merge() in QC. No value differences. Labels removed from both sides before comparison. Labels are verified separately against the spec by xportr (Step 5, 0 label mismatches).
